Item-to-text mapping established from the study's own replication materials on Harvard Dataverse (doi:10.7910/DVN/UMRAM7): the Stata file's variable labels name the original Swedish source variable for six of these items (a=kvinnorRattigheter, c=FoljaLagar, d=KritiseraRegeringen, f=ValjaLedare, g=BetalaSkatt, i=AnvandaVald), and Replication_do_file.do builds the 8-item democratic-values scale as values1a+values1c+values1d+values1e+values1f+values1g+values1i+values1j. The two unlabeled scale items (e, j) are fixed by order: they are the two reverse-worded statements, and the six labeled anchors confirm the codebook lists its statements in letter order. Live items values_b/_h/_k/_l are not part of this scale and no wording for them is published, so they are omitted. Responses were recoded so that higher values mean more support for democratic principles; for the two reverse-worded items (e, j) the option labels are therefore inverted relative to the other six.
